results.name: All six views and five agreements render without script errors
Coverage decision uses a real valid form and retains exact source
Crop-window deferral retains the original occurrence
Owned request and reviewed partial result remain separate
Remaining request uses the owned follow-up date and one task
Generation and successor plan retain generated occurrence identities
Renewal review and commercial proposal do not change agreement dates
Read-only and denied roles remove mutation controls and selected context
Lost confirmation recovers the original saved effect once
Failed save preserves form values and original state
Every selected view renders after the complete journey

limits: JSDOM with native dialog, scroll and URL download stubs; no native layout or browser proof.
